summary: Context-only committee read: the tape is risk-on and the risk radar has receded to calm, with 21-day pullback incidence measured at 13.0% versus a 17.8% base rate. Breadth is healthy and credit/funding conditions are calm, but the confirmed US Q2 regime label is no longer supported by its own axes: raw signs indicate Q3, with growth -0.27 and inflation +0.68, currently only 1 of 7 confirmation sessions. Liquidity is contracting in an orderly drain, real yields are restrictive and near a five-year extreme, the curve has shifted to a bear steepener, dealer gamma has turned short, and systematic allocators are pausing. These observations constrain confidence; they do not originate a position, score, ranking, or escalation.
what_fired: Risk radar de-escalation is eligible: internals, growth-scare, and bubble keys have receded; no fresh recovery confirmation chips fired.
US regime transition watch: displayed Q2 versus raw Q3, pending 1/7 sessions.
Options contradiction: 10 existing US buy-lane names show five-day-rising OTM-put skew; de-escalation context only.
Factor Pair G did not fire: ledger is dormant because the panel has only 11 dates and has not met the 60-date floor.
No new metabolism hypothesis was staked: the available evidence did not justify consuming the three-per-week budget without first reading a bounded causal or context candidate.
contradictions_review: The confluence graph contains two current contradictions: ticker-level demand-versus-supply divergences against the briefing, and rising put skew against 10 US buy-lane names. Factor contradictions are unavailable rather than absent: Pair G is dormant pending sufficient panel history. Master-brain review found no direct conflict between the current confluence contradictions and the semiconductors or growth-over-value theses; however, the thesis ledger itself has many open rows past their check_by dates, weakening accountability until they are scored or closed. The China-overweight thesis also deserves human re-review against broader context showing China/HK in Q4 with contracting liquidity, HK weak-side peg pressure, and offshore selling into hot turnover, although that broader disagreement was not one of the two typed confluence contradictions returned today.
decaying_families: Radar claims show negative signed excess across 5-, 21-, and 63-day kernel rows and remain unarmed; current calm state should be treated as contextual de-escalation, not an edge.
US board performance deteriorates from positive Q1 signed excess to negative Q2 results at 5 and 10 days; pooled weighting remains unarmed because it loses out of sample.
Policy, White House, stock-desk, thematic-desk, and AI-desk families have negative signed-excess kernel estimates and are unarmed.
Alt-data is mildly positive at five days but negative at 21 days and fails its out-of-sample arming test.
CA/HK board kernel results use unsigned MFE proxies and their held-out allocation tests are vacuous; they cannot establish directional reliability.
deserves_operator: US regime label/axes divergence: observe whether raw Q3 persists through the seven-session confirmation requirement; do not anticipate the flip.
Open-thesis ledger governance: score or close every thesis past its check_by date before treating the brief's track record as current.
Review the 10-name options contradiction cohort only as potential de-escalation of existing buy-lane keys; persistence criterion is at least five names retaining or increasing skew.
Re-review the open China-overweight thesis against Q4 growth-scare, contracting liquidity, weak-side HK peg pressure, and the offshore-outflow/hot-turnover contradiction.
Treat factor conclusions as coverage-limited: 11 panel dates, no Pair G ledger, zero factor-attention firings, and no A2 authority grant.
